string-array.name: setup_steps_spotify
string-array.item: Open the portal and sign in with your Spotify account (Premium is required).
Tap "Create app": name and description are up to you.
Paste the redirect URI below into "Redirect URIs" and press Add.
Tick "Web API" and save.
Open the app you just created, go to Settings and copy the Client ID here.

string-array.name: setup_steps_youtube
string-array.item: Open console.cloud.google.com and create a project (any name, for example Songport).
Menu, "APIs and services", "Library": search YouTube Data API v3 and press Enable.
Menu, "Google Auth Platform", "Overview", "Get started": app name, your e-mail as support address, audience External, your e-mail as contact. Create.
Still in Google Auth Platform, open "Audience": under "Test users" press "Add users" and add your own Gmail address. Without this step Google refuses the login.
Google Auth Platform, "Clients", "Create client": application type Desktop app. Copy the client ID and the client secret here. No redirect to register: the app listens on 127.0.0.1.

string-array.name: setup_steps_tidal
string-array.item: Open the TIDAL developer portal and sign in.
Create a new app.
Paste the redirect URI below among the Redirect URIs.
Copy the Client ID here.

string-array.name: setup_steps_deezer
string-array.item: Open developers.deezer.com and create a new application.
Deezer only accepts https redirects. A ready-made redirect page is already filled in below: use that address as both application domain and redirect URL (or host docs/deezer-redirect.html yourself).
Copy the Application ID here.

string-array.name: setup_steps_apple
string-array.item: You need the Apple Developer Program (99 $/year) and a MusicKit key.
Create the key, download the .p8 file, note the Key ID and the Team ID.
Generate the ES256 JWT (the README has a ready-made script) and paste it here.
It expires after six months at most: when it stops working, generate a new one.

string-array.name: setup_steps_lastfm
string-array.item: Open the Last.fm API page and sign in with your Last.fm account.
Fill in the form (name and description are up to you, no callback needed) and submit.
Copy the API key here.

resources.string: Connect a music service, then create your first sync. It takes a minute.
Tap "New sync": pick a source playlist and where it should go.
Every sync leaves a report here: what was added, removed or not found.
Backup and duplicate cleanup work on the services you have connected.
You log in on each service\'s official page. Songport never sees your password.

Songport is free, with no subscriptions and no locked features. One small banner, never full-screen, pays for the developer\'s coffee and the hours spent keeping every service working. If it ever bothers you, open an issue on GitHub.
If you feel like it, buy the developer a coffee on Ko-fi. Totally optional: nothing is unlocked, the app stays complete for everyone.
